answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 40 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Anyone wanting 85 effective identities must lock that capital for 40 epochs and keep it locked through every jetty audit. That is 16 dollars per alias.
